name: Narrative Arc Mapping Rubric
description: Evaluation criteria for mapping researched evidence onto structural steps without fabricating the steps the evidence cannot fill. Scores the triage, the warrants, the absence handling, and the handoff discipline.

criteria.name: Absence Reporting
criteria.description: Whether empty structural slots were reported as findings rather than silently filled

scores.1: All 22 steps filled; ghosts, betrayals, or fake-ally opponents invented to complete the shape
scores.2: Most steps filled with at least one clearly invented slot; no triage table emitted
scores.3: Triage table emitted with PRESENT/ABSENT/NOT APPLICABLE, but ABSENT entries carry no reason
scores.4: At least one step reported ABSENT with a stated reason; empty-slot log present with a move chosen per slot
scores.5: Full triage with sourced PRESENT entries and reasoned ABSENT entries; mandatory seven verified; inference-filled slots capped at one and none at the climax; empty-slot log ships with the deliverable

criteria.name: Evidentiary Warrant per Slot
criteria.description: Whether each filled slot carries dated sourcing, a causal tier, and the substitution test where required

scores.1: No sourcing per slot; the architecture exists only inside the narrative
scores.2: Some slots cited; no dates, no source-type or interest tags, no causal tiers
scores.3: Most slots cited with dates; causal tiers assigned but rivals unnamed and no substitution test
scores.4: Warrant card per slot with four dates and a causal tier; RETROSPECTIVE-ONLY slots tagged and hedged
scores.5: Every warrant card complete, including two named alternative events a differently-ending narrator would have chosen; source type and interest tagged; no documented-mechanism claim rests on a purely secondary retrospective account

criteria.name: Hindsight-Determinism Control
criteria.description: Whether backward derivation from the known outcome was gated on contemporaneous evidence

scores.1: Starting weakness manufactured to make the ending look inevitable; supported only by post-hoc commentary
scores.2: Weakness asserted with retrospective sourcing presented as if contemporaneous
scores.3: Contemporaneous sources sought; some weaknesses gated, others left unmarked
scores.4: Every claimed weakness carries a pre-outcome citation or is marked INFERRED and kept out of the climax
scores.5: Full gate plus source-interest annotation, the flip test on evaluative sentences about decisions, and decision quality stated separately from outcome quality

criteria.name: Opponent Integrity
criteria.description: Whether the opponent slot was warranted rather than assigned to whoever lost

scores.1: Opponent is whoever lost; motive backfilled as stupidity or malice; intent verbs attached to an abstraction
scores.2: Opponent asserted with one evidence type; no justification paragraph
scores.3: Two of three warrant evidence types present; opponent correctly demoted to rival but verbs not constrained
scores.4: Three-of-three warrant or an honest demotion to rival/environment with verbs constrained accordingly; justification paragraph written
scores.5: Warrant scored and verbs constrained; justification passes the recognition test; a mystery substituted at the same structural position where no opponent exists; manufactured-conflict check run on the shared scarce object

criteria.name: Designing Principle Discrimination
criteria.description: Whether the designing principle is a strategy that cuts material, not a premise or a theme in disguise

scores.1: No designing principle, or a plot summary with more abstract vocabulary
scores.2: One candidate only; contains a should or an ought; excludes nothing
scores.3: Multiple candidates drafted; the winner passes process and abstract gates but no exclusions are named
scores.4: Passes all four gates with three excluded claims named explicitly
scores.5: All four gates passed with named exclusions, all layers derived (world, shape, symbol, inclusion criterion), rival arcs matrixed with the runner-up and its favouring evidence disclosed

criteria.name: Revelation Sequence Rigor
criteria.description: Whether revelations were extracted, sequenced, and rated by course change rather than by language

scores.1: No revelation sequence, or two to three plot points only
scores.2: Reveals listed but exposition is mislabelled as revelation
scores.3: Reveals extracted with sources; intensity assigned but justified by adjectives
scores.4: Intensity rated by the size of the course change forced; monotonic climb verified; pace accelerates
scores.5: Full audit with count target met for length, bend-not-break enforced, the three decision points carrying all four co-occurring elements, and every reorder date-checked against sources

criteria.name: Theme Enactment Discipline
criteria.description: Whether the moral argument is carried structurally, or narrated, or forced onto neutral material

scores.1: Theme stated in narrator voice throughout, or a villain manufactured for value-neutral material
scores.2: Spine built but the lesson is also stated in prose in several places
scores.3: Spine built with evidence mapping; explicit moral language leaks outside the permitted positions once or twice
scores.4: Explicit moral language confined to the three permitted positions; unsupported spine elements left visibly EMPTY
scores.5: As level 4, plus a correct explanatory-mode declaration where warranted, a balance check of moral beats against event beats, and a double reversal producing a defensible third position

criteria.name: Handoff Discipline
criteria.description: Whether the output stopped at a tagged scene weave instead of drifting into drafting

scores.1: Prose drafted; the craft layer inherits text to edit rather than architecture to execute
scores.2: Scene descriptions run to paragraphs; construction fields absent
scores.3: One line per scene but over the character limit, or missing step and reveal tags
scores.4: Tagged one-line weave within the character limit, with construction fields filled per scene
scores.5: Complete weave: tagged, ordered by structure, date-checked, scenes carrying no step and no reveal cut, gaps filled, construction fields complete, and nothing written beyond it

passing_note: Average score must be >= 3.5. A score below 3 in 'Absence Reporting' or 'Evidentiary Warrant per Slot' is a hard fail regardless of average: an architecture that filled every slot or cannot show its sources is fabrication, not mapping.
